subject.title: [Bug]: Session transcript mirroring writes header cwd from process.cwd(), allowing cross-agent workspace contamination

question: Should maintainers rebase/adopt the existing open fix PR, replace it with a fresh narrow patch, or defer this transcript cwd isolation fix?
rationale: The bug is source-reproducible and security/session-state sensitive, but an external open closing PR already owns the same path and is currently conflicting, so ClawSweeper should not open a parallel fix without maintainer direction.

options.title: Repair or replace the open fix PR
options.body: Rebase/adopt https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/50454 or close it after opening a narrow replacement that resolves the target workspace before header creation.

options.title: Defer while keeping this issue open
options.body: Leave this issue open as the canonical bug if maintainers want a broader cwd/workspace cleanup before touching transcript headers.

options.title: Close without fixing
options.body: Close only if maintainers decide the remaining ordinary mirror fallback is acceptable despite the source and production evidence.

recommendation.title: Repair or replace the open fix PR
recommendation.body: Rebase/adopt https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/50454 or close it after opening a narrow replacement that resolves the target workspace before header creation.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the delivery mirroring path and has recent session transcript history, making them the best available routing owner from the evidence.
